fact: In September 2023 Startup São Tomé, a private technology-based incubator, ran a two-day programme with Acelera Angola for about 20 entrepreneurs at REINA, with cash prizes for the best business ideas.
title: Empreendedores são-tomenses e angolanos debatem criação de ecossistema privado de empreendedorismo
publisher: Rádio Nacional de São Tomé e Príncipe
